value.body: Once a tour is sold, the operations team makes it happen. A tour operations executive books hotels, coaches, cars and guides, prepares the day-wise schedule, and sorts out problems while travellers are on the road. Employers are tour operators, destination-management companies and travel agencies, including firms that handle inbound foreign tourists.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Booking portals, Excel, supplier contracts, messaging apps

items.label: Work pattern
items.value: Office-based with on-call duty while tours are running

items.label: Domestic tourist visits
items.note: Counts visits, not unique people; up ~17.5% over 2023

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join tour operators or destination-management companies as operations trainees, often after an internship. Knowledge of a region's routes and hotels, or a foreign language for inbound tourism, helps.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: operations manager, product manager, destination specialist.
On-call work during tours and peak seasons is common.
Business depends on tourist seasons and on events that disrupt travel.

value.title: Domestic tourist visits
value.note: State-reported visit counts, rounded; one person can be counted many times. 2022 was still affected by Covid-19.
value.source: Ministry of Tourism, India Tourism Statistics / Data Compendium (as reported)
